verdict.rationale: Vue says it builds on standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Several hands-on reports describe single-file .vue components that combine HTML, JS and scoped CSS in one file, and some name this as Vue's best feature. Some users note the template layer adds its own directive syntax, and complex tree renders can be harder than in plain-JS JSX; TSX is an option but rarely used. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the single-file component format itself, and evidence that templating uses only familiar syntax rather than Vue-specific directives.
